columns.title: Jahmyr Gibbs scored 49.2 on Thanksgiving, and the rest of this league should be embarrassed
columns.dek: Allen-tents & Purposes has 133.74 before Black Friday. Everybody else is playing for second.
body: Let me tell you what Thanksgiving looked like from the RedDevil904 couch. Jahmyr Gibbs: 205 rushing yards, three touchdowns, five catches, 49.2 points. DeVonta Smith: 11 catches, 200 yards, two touchdowns, 45.0. D'Andre Swift: 29.2. That's 123.4 points from three players, on a Thursday, while the turkey was still resting.

Allen-tents & Purposes was already the best team in this league. It's 8‑3, it scores 140.2 a week, it has an 89‑32 all-play and it's at 91 percent for a bye. And Josh Allen scored 3.54. Think about that. The quarterback had his worst day of the year and the team still has 133.74 with three starters to go.

I'm hearing DeVonta Smith has asked RedDevil904 for the locker right next to Jahmyr Gibbs so they can compare box scores. Word is he loves the vibe on Allen-tents & Purposes, thinks it's the best room in the league, and has told people he's never going back to a team that starts him at flex.

Meanwhile, the rest of you. Your Mom’s Magic Dick has 19.60. JTWaddlesHisPurdyJohnson has 0.00. I Pulled My McCaff, the second-best team on paper, is losing to Bill_Buttlicker. So here's the column in one line for everyone not named RedDevil904. YOU'RE ALL PLAYING FOR SECOND!

columns.title: Wednesday night film and the Thanksgiving depth chart
columns.dek: Six league starters played in Los Angeles. One of them did his job like a pro.
body: Short session. Six league starters on the tape from Wednesday night. Grades are final.

Blake Corum. 28.5 for I Pulled My McCaff from the flex. That's a starter's day out of a flex spot. Grade: A. Kyren Williams. 16.5 for Likely Cookin That Diaper. Did the job. Grade: B-plus. Christian Watson. 16.5 for YourMomsGivin’ Bijan’s. Grade: B-plus.

The Rams defense. 12.0 for Rome Alone. Grade: B. Matthew Golden. 4.9 for Allen-tents & Purposes. Grade: D. Tucker Kraft. 3.4 on three catches for Slippery Balls. Bad points, good catch count, and the catch count pays this week. Grade: C.

Word around the I Pulled My McCaff facility is that Blake Corum wants a locker room where the team name is about him for once. I'm told he doesn't dislike Hing1eMcCring13berry. He just noticed the name on the jersey and it wasn't his.

Thanksgiving depth chart. Allen-tents & Purposes: five starters today. Rome Alone: five. Likely Cookin That Diaper: three, all in one game. McCallyCockin(his butt): two, and down 28.50. YourMomsGivin’ Bijan’s: Javonte Williams, and Deshaun Watson starting over Tyler Shough after Cam Ward got cut. I don't grade that until I see the tape. I'll be watching.

columns.title: Five Black Friday moves from a strategist who has never once lost a Friday
columns.dek: Seven league starters play in Pittsburgh tonight. Here's how to handle them, numbered, for your convenience.
body: Thanksgiving is in the books and the professionals are back at work. Denver plays at Pittsburgh tonight with seven league starters, and most of you have no plan. I have five.

1. Skatabooboo: you have 3.90 and eight starters left. The only way to guarantee the score doesn't go down is to stop starting people. Bench everybody for Sunday. A score you can't lose is a score you can't lose. 2. JTWaddlesHisPurdyJohnson: you're at 0.00, which is technically the best defense in the league. Jaylen Waddle plays tonight. Consider benching him to protect the shutout.

3. Hing1eMcCring13berry: you trail by 0.60. Jaylen Warren is your only player tonight, and one good drive puts you ahead. Do not watch. Watching is how momentum gets jinxed. 4. tballsmccall: new team name, new you. Start Bo Nix, obviously, and when he scores, take the credit for naming the team after him. Correlation is causation if you post it first. 5. ChuckJ10: the Denver defense has the whole night to itself. Root for zero points against, and also root for Bo Nix. Hedging is a sign of maturity.

Sources say Bo Nix has heard about bo’sBENdingyouover😘😘 and has quietly asked his agent whether he can be traded to a roster with a name his parents can say out loud. I'm told tballsmccall took it as a compliment and has no plans to change it before the Week 11 video gets posted, which means never.

columns.title: The Thanksgiving Exposure Index says Allen-tents & Purposes already won Week 12
columns.dek: Five starters today, 140.2 points a week, and a model that does not do humility.
body: I built a new metric overnight. The Thanksgiving Exposure Index counts how many starters a team has playing on Thanksgiving and multiplies it by season scoring. Allen-tents & Purposes: five starters times 140.2 points a game. Rome Alone: five times 120.7. I Pulled My McCaff: zero times 139.1. Zero times anything is zero. That's not my opinion. That's multiplication.

The obvious conclusion is that the turkey decides the week. Allen-tents & Purposes leads the index, is 91 percent for a bye in Erection Projections, and is a 21.8-point favorite. Correlation is causation when it's this clean. I Pulled My McCaff scored a league-best 28.5 on Wednesday with Blake Corum, and the index gives it no credit, because Wednesday is not Thanksgiving. The index is very strict.

Sources say Jared Goff has quietly asked around about whether Shootyeah reads the injury report, after watching him swap the Kansas City defense for Cincinnati on Wednesday. I'm told he likes the vibe in the locker room. He'd like it more with a win, and Slippery Balls is 3‑8 and a 20.8-point dog.

Bottom line: Likely Cookin That Diaper has three starters in one game, Kansas City at Buffalo, which the index scores as one big starter. Skatabooboo has Rashee Rice in the same game, which the index scores as a donation. Line: Likely Cookin That Diaper by 37.9. The model has spoken. It doesn't take questions.

The stakes are real. I'm 7‑4 and at 87 percent. Hing1eMcCring13berry is 6‑5 and at 90 percent because the sim knows who scores more. Your Mom’s Magic Dick is 6‑5 at 36 percent and plays Allen-tents & Purposes, so whoever loses this one is the team Cavemanfsu is chasing.
